name: AI Quantitative Trading Techniques
description: Master index of categorized AI/ML techniques for quantitative stock analysis. Compiled from multi-team research operation with independent verification.

categories.name: Machine Learning Trading Strategies
categories.description: Supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning approaches for trade signal generation and strategy discovery.

categories.name: AI Portfolio Optimization
categories.description: AI-driven portfolio construction, asset allocation, rebalancing, and multi-objective optimization.

categories.name: AI Risk Management
categories.description: ML methods for risk modeling, tail-risk estimation, stress testing, anomaly detection, and dynamic hedging.

categories.name: Data Pipelines & Infrastructure
categories.description: Feature stores, MLOps, backtesting frameworks, data versioning, and model serving for quantitative finance.

categories.name: Alternative Data Sources
categories.description: Non-traditional data sources including satellite imagery, credit card data, web scraping, geolocation, and ESG signals.

categories.name: High-Frequency Trading
categories.description: AI/ML for microsecond-scale trading: order book modeling, latency optimization, and adaptive execution.

categories.name: NLP & Sentiment Analysis
categories.description: Financial text analysis: earnings calls, news sentiment, SEC filing parsing, and LLM-based market analysis.

categories.name: Explainable AI & Governance
categories.description: Model interpretability, regulatory compliance (EU AI Act, SR 11-7), audit trails, and governance frameworks.

contributing_teams.findings: Grading script, schemas, final report compilation

methodology: Multi-team parallel research with independent verification. Teams 1 and 2 researched via web search. Teams 3 and 4 verified via citation checking, claim verification, and automated grading. Team 5 built infrastructure and compiled final report.
